reactions.label: REFLEXIVE SYNCHRONIZATION
reactions.description: When Yo Hiori has possession and Isagi is on the pitch, Isagi makes a timed forward run and Hiori plays a highly accurate lofted cross to him. The one-tick combination can still be intercepted. Shared 10-tick cooldown.

reactions.name: Planet Hotline
reactions.label: PLANET HOTLINE
